events.factual_description: SOUTH Jazz Kitchen presents The Quantum Blues Quartet on Sunday, September 13, 2026, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM, in collaboration with the Outsiders Improvised & Creative Music Festival. SOUTH identifies the quartet as Tisziji Muñoz, Will Calhoun, Jamaaladeen Tacuma, and Paul Shaffer and describes the project as avant-funk. Tisziji Muñoz's official event page confirms the Philadelphia date and instruments: Muñoz on guitar, Shaffer on keys, Tacuma on bass, and Calhoun on drums. Ropeadope documents that the project originated in a 2024 New York session in which the musicians played without charts, preparation, or prearranged material; the resulting album Quantum Blues was released April 25, 2025. SOUTH describes its jazz club as an intimate room with fewer than 75 seats.

en.why_it_matters: This quartet is built around collision rather than polite all-star assembly: Tisziji Muñoz's searching electric guitar, Jamaaladeen Tacuma's elastic bass language, Will Calhoun's rock power and polyrhythmic reach, and Paul Shaffer working as an improvising keyboard player. Quantum Blues began with no charts and no prearranged material, so the point of the live set is what these four do to one another in real time. Putting that chemistry into SOUTH's sub-75-seat room, inside the Outsiders festival, gives the Philadelphia date a particularly good frame.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, I would seriously consider a dedicated Philadelphia run for one of these two sets if electric improvisation and groove are the point of the trip; the small room is unusually well matched to the quartet. If another Philadelphia reason is already on the weekend, this becomes an especially easy night to build around.

es.why_it_matters: Este cuarteto funciona por choque, no como una reunión amable de nombres: la guitarra eléctrica de Tisziji Muñoz, el bajo elástico de Jamaaladeen Tacuma, la potencia rockera y el alcance polirrítmico de Will Calhoun, y Paul Shaffer tocando como tecladista improvisador. Quantum Blues nació sin partituras ni material arreglado de antemano, así que el punto del directo es escuchar qué se provocan estos cuatro en tiempo real. Meter esa química en una sala de menos de 75 personas como SOUTH, dentro del festival Outsiders, le da a la fecha de Filadelfia un marco especialmente bueno.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV sí contemplaría una subida dedicada a Filadelfia para uno de los dos sets si el motivo del viaje es la improvisación eléctrica y el groove; la sala pequeña le queda particularmente bien al cuarteto. Si el fin de semana ya trae otra razón para estar en Philly, esta fecha se vuelve muy fácil de construir alrededor.
